---
title: "Privacy"
toc: false
number-sections: false
---

This site uses Google Analytics to count visits: which pages are read, roughly where visitors come
from (country, referring site) and what device and browser they use. There are no ads, and the
data isn't used to identify anyone.

Google Analytics loads only if you accept cookies in the banner. If you decline, or ignore the banner,
nothing is sent to Google and no cookies are set. You can change your choice at any time with
"Cookie preferences" at the bottom of every page.

When enabled, Google Analytics sets cookies (`_ga`, `_ga_*`) that keep a random visitor identifier for
up to two years, and Google processes the data under its own
[privacy policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy). The site itself is hosted on GitHub Pages,
which keeps its own server logs ([GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)).

Questions: open an issue on [the repository](https://github.com/kmamykin/iom_cfd/issues).
